name: omo-latest
purpose: Repository-owned latest skill assets for `bun tools/package-native.mjs --skill-source latest`. Staging reads ONLY this overlay, so the pinned checkout can never silently contribute latest assets.

AGENTS.md.note: Pool-root developer doc; mirrored in the overlay, not a staged skill.

browserRuntime.note: The browser skill's engine runtime is build-materialized, never committed (see runtime/.gitignore), exactly as upstream gitignores skills/browser/runtime/omowright/. `--skill-source latest` requires --omowright-runtime <dir> and refuses a content-only browser tree; the staged manifest records this identity plus each runtime file's sha256. This is packaging of upstream skill content only: no desktop/browser implementation, engine authorization or extension bridge.

mc:H1.note: Latest BUILTIN_SKILL_NAMES = 25 names (adds browser, ulw-execute; drops start-work). Recorded as targetNames; the native list (crates/omo/components/maho-omo-telemetry/src/product_identity.rs) is owned by another lane and is NOT edited here.

mc:H2.title: skill staging / drift guard
mc:H2.note: Native analog is tools/package-native.mjs: pinned drift guard preserved, latest mode adds overlay file-set + declared-sha256 integrity; the sync-skills copy filter (ignored dirs/files, *.test.ts, *.pyc, scripts/tests) is mirrored by shouldSkipEntry().

loader.resolution: crates/omo/maho-omo/src/component_list.rs: SKILLS_ROOT_ENV + builtin_skills_root() (a set non-empty env root wins, else <exe dir>/skills, else relative skills); consumed in crates/maho-cli/src/cli/omo_mount.rs:38-40 (env root -> OMO_SENPI_PLUGIN_ROOT/skills -> builtin_skills_root). The staged manifest records sources.latestAssets.loader = { skillsRoot: "skills", env: "OMO_SENPI_SKILLS_ROOT" }.
loader.invocation: bun tools/package-native.mjs --binary <mhc> --output <install> --skill-source latest --git-bash-binary <omo-git-bash> --omowright-runtime <materialized runtime dir>; the installed tree is then exercised through the native app-server: `mhc app-server --listen stdio://` with MAHO_CODING_AGENT_DIR=<install> and JSON-RPC `skills/list` (crates/maho-server/src/app_server/skills.rs). The OMO packaged root itself (OMO_SENPI_SKILLS_ROOT -> builtin_skills_root()) is consumed by the onboarding/init-deep-advisor/mass-ulw skill pointers and by the telemetry skill_loaded event (crates/omo/components/maho-omo-telemetry/src/omo_native_tools.rs::builtin_skill_name); it has no CLI/RPC list surface of its own.

contentBinding.mechanism: The overlay declares each selected skill's complete file set; staging refuses a set that differs (a missing or extra file is `latest overlay is incomplete`). Every staged file is hashed into the package manifest at stage time, and every non-null declared sha256 is checked against the overlay bytes before staging. The declared bindings for the remaining files are completed at the global final gate (the authoring window forbids hash computation).
